text.p: For The Three For the Six
Months Ended June 30, Months Ended June 30,
NOTE (a) The amounts for 1996 have been restated to reflect acquisitions made during 1996 using the pooling-of-interests method of accounting.

During the quarter ended June 30, 1997, Allied closed the previously announced purchase and refinancing of all of the seller notes and warrants issued to Laidlaw Inc as partial consideration for the purchase of Laidlaw's solid waste business in 1996. Also, as previously announced, during this quarter Allied replaced its bank credit facility with an improved $900 million bank agreement. As a result of these transactions, Allied recorded a one-time, after-tax extraordinary refinancing charge of $52.4 million, or $0.60 per share.
